title: Union Eyes production: enforce RLS on the 12 tables failing rls-verify preflight
description: Business justification: the production deploy gate (rls-verify preflight) fails 12 of 1167 checks, so production cannot pass its own isolation gate. Security rationale: 12 manifest-required public-schema tables have RLS off, FORCE off and no policies; union_eyes_runtime (NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS) currently holds no privileges on them and they hold 0 rows, so there is no current cross-tenant exposure, but any future grant would be unisolated. Affected tables: workbooks, workbook_modules, workbook_purchases, workbook_memory_holders, workbook_governance_lineage_entries, audit_logs, organization_users, compliance_snapshots, domain_events, evidence_packs, integration_idempotency_keys, integration_registry. Desired state: RLS + FORCE + runtime and system policies on all 12. Migration plan: apply db/migrations/20261005_prod_rls_closure_twelve_tables.sql once via scripts/apply-prod-rls-closure-twelve-tables.ts as union_eyes_migration_admin, in one transaction with in-transaction assertions. Validation plan: dry-run and apply on a schema-faithful clone of production (1167/1167), idempotency re-apply, 94/94 cross-tenant isolation tests, rollback validated; then rls-verify preflight against production must be 1167/1167. No grants, roles, functions or other tables are touched. Approver: Aubert Nungisa (anungis437), platform owner, sole platform user, holding both the service_owner and change_manager roles; authorized 2026-10-05. Detail: ops/change-records/CHG-2026-0110.md.
impact_summary: Blast radius: 12 empty public-schema tables on which union_eyes_runtime has no privileges; no application path reads or writes them today. One transaction, auto-rolled back on any failed assertion. No grants, role, function or other table changes. Application behavior unchanged.
rollback_plan: Run apps/union-eyes scripts/apply-prod-rls-closure-twelve-tables.ts --rollback (db/migrations/20261005_prod_rls_closure_twelve_tables_rollback.sql): drops the created policies and disables RLS/FORCE on the same 12 tables, restoring the captured pre-change state. Validated on the production-schema clone (returns to 1155/1167). Safe because the tables hold 0 rows and the runtime role has no privileges on them.

post_implementation_review.observations: Applied once on 2026-10-06 as union_eyes_migration_admin after a passing production dry-run (transaction rolled back). 12/12 tables now RLS+FORCE with runtime and system policies. rls-verify preflight against production: 1167/1167; union_eyes_runtime rolsuper=false, rolbypassrls=false. Production /api/ready and /api/health stayed 200. SQL sha256 (LF) 717800a3cc493b0d1a22350eb9d4325f0e657fa7491446b5ecd425330fb5c882. Pre-validated on a schema-faithful clone (apply, re-apply, rollback, 94/94 cross-tenant tests). No grants were added; the runtime role still has no privileges on these tables, so tenant isolation of live traffic through them is not exercised yet. Whether to grant the manifest requiredRuntimePrivileges is a separate decision.
